questions.question: frac{{1 - tan A}}{{1 + tan A}} = frac{{tan 3^circ tan 15^circ tan 30^circ tan 75^circ tan 87^circ }}{{tan 27^circ tan 39^circ tan 51^circ tan 60^circ tan 63^circ }}, then the value of cot A is:
questions.solution:
**GIven:**

frac{{1 - tan A}}{{1 + tan A}} = frac{{tan 3^circ tan 15^circ tan 30^circ tan 75^circ tan 87^circ }}{{tan 27^circ tan 39^circ tan 51^circ tan 60^circ tan 63^circ }}

**Formula used:**

If A + B = 90° 

Then tan A × tan B = 1

Tanθ = 1/cotθ 

Tan 30° = 1/√3

Tan 60° = √3

**Calculation:**

Using the above formula 

⇒ tan 3° × tan 87° = 1

⇒ tan 15° × tan 75° = 1 

⇒ tan 27° × tan 63° = 1

⇒ tan 39° × tan 51° = 1

Put values in the given equation we get

⇒ (1 - tan A)/(1 + tan A) = (1/√3)/√3

⇒ (1 - tan A)/(1 + tan A) = 1/3

⇒ 3 - 3tan A = 1 + tan A

⇒ 4 tan A = 2

⇒ tan A = 2/4

⇒ cot A = 2

**∴ The value of cot A is 2.**

questions.question: If a SinA + b cosA = c, then a cosA - b sinA is equal to:
questions.solution:
**GIven:**

a SinA + b cosA = c

**Formula used:**

If a Sinθ + b Cosθ = c

Then, a Cosθ – b Sinθ = √ {{a²} + {b²} - {c²}}

**Calculation:**

Apply above formula on a SinA + b cosA = c 

We get

⇒ a CosA – b SinA = √ {{a²} + {b²} - {c²}}

**∴ a CosA – b SinA is equla to √ {{a²} + {b²} - {c²}}**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given, a sinA + b cosA = c -----(1)

Let, x = a cosA - b sinA -----(2)

On Square equation (1)

⇒ a² sin²A + b²cos²A + 2a sinA × b cosA = c² -----(3)

On Square equation (2)

⇒ a² cos²A + b² sin²A - 2a cosA × b sinA = x² -----(4)

On adding (3) and (4)

⇒ x² + c² = a² + b²

⇒ x = √(a² + b² - c²)

**∴ a CosA – b SinA is equla to √(a2 + b2 - c2).**

questions.question: Ravi starts for his school from his house on his cycle at 8:20 a.m. If he runs his cycle at a speed of 10 km/h, he reaches his school 8 minutes late, and if he drives the cycle at a speed of 16 km/h, he reaches his school 10 minutes early. The school starts at:
questions.solution:
**GIven:**

Ravi starts from his house to school at 8:20 a.m with speed of 10 km/h and reaches 8 minutess late

If he ride the cycle at speed of 16 km/h he reaches his school 10 minutes early

**Formula used:**

**Calculation:**

Let the distance between home and school be x km

And time take to reach school at the time be t hrs

With the speed of 10 km/h, Ravi reaches 8 minutes late

⇒ x/10 = t + 8/60

⇒ x/10 = t + 2/15 ----(1)

With the speed of 16 km/h, Ravi reaches 10 minutes early

⇒ x/16 = t – 10/60

⇒ x/16 = t – 1/6 ----(2)

Now, Subtract (2) from (1)

⇒ x/10 – x/16 = t + 2/15 – t + 1/6

⇒ (5x – 8x)/80 = (4 + 5)/30

⇒ 3x × 30 = 9 × 80

⇒ x = 720/90

⇒ x = 8 km

Now, put the value of x in (1)

⇒ 8/10 = t + 2/15

⇒ t = 8/10 – 2/15

⇒ t = (24 – 4)/30 

⇒ t = 2/3

To convert it into minutes by 60

⇒ (2/3) × 60 = 40 minutes

College starts at 8:20 + 40 mins = 9 A.M

**∴ College starts at 9 A.M**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd67c9563cdde4a0dfe99b7686282bc07365f691adfb64c907de66aebe4b011.png]

Ravi is 8 min late, the correct time will be

⇒ 48 - 8 = 40 minutes

College starts at 8:20 + 40 mins = 9 A.M

∴ College starts at 9 A.M

A circle is inscribed in the triangle ABC whose sides are given as AB = 10, BC = 8, CA = 12 units as shown in the figure. The value of AD × BF is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB = 10 units, BC = 8 units, and CA = 12 units

**Concept Used:**

The length of two tangents drawn on the same circle, from the same external point is same.

**Calculation:**

⇒ AD = AE, CD = CF, BE = BF

Let AD = AE be x, CD = CF be y, and BE = BF be z.

AB = AE + EB

⇒ 10 = x + z ----(1)

BC = BF + FC 

⇒ 8 = z + y ----(2)

AC = AD + DC

⇒ 12 = x + y ----(3)

Adding equation 1, 2 and 3, we get

⇒ 30 = x + z + z + y + x + y

⇒ 30 = 2 (x + y + z)

⇒ x + y + z = 15

From equation 1, x + z = 10

⇒ y = 15 – (x + z)

⇒ y = 15 – (10)

⇒ y = 5

From equation 2, z + y = 8

⇒ x = 15 – (y + z)

⇒ x = 15 – (8)

⇒ x = 7

From equation 3, x + y = 12

⇒ z = 15 – (x + y)

⇒ z = 15 – 12

⇒ z = 3

Now AD × BF,

⇒ x × z

⇒ 7 × 3

⇒ 21

**∴ The value of AD × BF is 21.**

questions.question: A person purchased 40 items at some price. He sold some items at a profit of 30% by selling them at a price equal to the cost price of 26 items. The remaining items are sold at 18% profit. The total profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total items purchased = 40 items

Sold some items at 30% profit 

Remaining items sold at 18% profit 

**Formula Used:**

SP = (100 + Profit%)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be 40x

And number of items sold at 30% profit be y

⇒ Cost price of y items = xy

⇒ Selling price of y items = 130/100 × (xy)

According to the question,

Selling price of y items = Cost price of 26 items

⇒ 130/100 × (xy) = 26x

⇒ 13/10 × y = 26

⇒ y = 20

⇒ Number of items sold at 30% profit = 20

Remaining items sold at profit 18%,

⇒ 40 – 20 = 20

Selling price of items sold at 30%,

⇒ 130/100 × 20x = 26x

Selling price of items sold at 18%, 

⇒ 118/100 × 20x = 23.6x

Total profit percent,

⇒ (26x + 23.6x – 40x)/40x × 100

⇒ 9.6/40 × 100 = 24%

**∴ Total profit percentage is 24%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

Let the CP of 40 items be Rs.100

⇒ Total CP = 40 × 100 = 4,000

Let say he sold x items at 30% profit

⇒ SP of x items = x × 130/100 × 100

⇒ SP of x items = x × 130

Which is equal to the CP of 26 items.

⇒ x × 130 = 26 × 100

⇒ x = 20

He sold 20 items at 30% profit,

⇒ Total SP of 20 items = Rs. 2,600 

⇒ Remaining items = 40 – 20 ⇒ 20

He sold remaining items at 18% profit 

⇒ Remaining 20 articles SP = 20 × 118/100 × 100

⇒ Remaining 20 articles SP = Rs.2,360

Total SP of 40 articles = 2,600 + 2,360 ⇒ Rs.4,960

Total SP of 40 articles = Rs.4,960

Profit % = (SP – CP)/CP × 100

⇒ Profit % = (4,960 – 4,000)/4,000 × 100

Profit % = 960/4000 × 100 ⇒ 24% 

∴ Total profit percentage is 24%

questions.question: If the value of frac{{3xsqrt y + 2ysqrt x }}{{3xsqrt y - 2ysqrt x }} - frac{{3xsqrt y - 2ysqrt x }}{{3xsqrt y + 2ysqrt x }} is same as that of sqrt xsqrt y, then which of the following relations between x and y is correct?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

[(3x√y + 2y√x)/(3x√y - 2y√x)] - [(3x√y - 2y√x)/(3x√y + 2y√x)] = √x × √y

**Concept Used:**

We need to take LCM and simplify the equation.

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² - (a - b)² = 4ab

(a² - b²) = (a + b)(a - b)

**Calculation:**

Take a = 3x√y and b = 2y√x

Given expression will be transformed to [(a + b)/(a - b)] - [(a - b)/(a + b)]

⇒ [(a + b)² - (a - b)²]/[(a + b)(a - b)] = √(xy)

⇒ 4ab/(a² - b²) = √(xy)

⇒ (4 × 3x√y × 2y√x)/[(3x√y)² - (2y√x)²] = √(xy)

⇒ (24x√x × y√y)/(9x²y - 4y²x) = √(xy)

⇒ [24 × xy × √(xy)]/[(xy)(9x - 4y) = √(xy)

⇒ 24/(9x - 4y) = 1

⇒ 9x - 4y = 24

**∴ The correct relation between x and y is 9x - 4y = 24**

questions.question: A man has Rs. 10,000. He lent a part of it at 15% simple interest and the remaining at 10% simple interest. The total interest he received after 5 years amounted to Rs. 6,500. The difference between the parts of the amounts he lent is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs 10,000

Some part of money lent at 15%

Some part of it lent at 10%

Total interest earned = Rs. 6,500

Time = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the money lent at 15% be x

Then money lent at 10% be (10,000 - x)

6,500 = [(x × 15 × 5)/100] + [(10,000 - x) × 10 × 5]/100

⇒ 6,500 = (3x/4) + [(10,000 - x)/2]

⇒ 6,500 = (3x + 20,000 - 2x)/4

⇒ 26,000 = 20,000 + x

⇒ x = Rs 6,000

Then,

(10,000 - x) = (10,000 - 6,000) = Rs 4,000

Difference between the two sums lent = Rs 6,000 - Rs 4,000

⇒ Difference between the two sums lent = Rs 2,000

**∴ The difference between the sums lent is Rs 2,000.**

⇒ 2,000 Rs.

**Given:**

Radius of the circle = 5cm 

Length of the tangent from point P to circle = 12 cm 

**Formula Used:**

Pythagoras theorem

(PO)² =(PT)² + (AT)² 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9101b3ce2d4d6e5c876a560ec0641b1ab3d35414d1057d43c60fcc6fd8b1f68.png] 

**Calculation:**

OT = 5 cm (radius)

OA = 5 cm (radius)

Let the value of PA be X

The tangent PT is perpendicular to OT 

By Pythagoras theorem,

(PO)2 =(PT)2 + (OT)2

PO = PA + OA = X + 5

substituting the value in the formula

(PO)² = 12² + 5²

⇒ (PO)2 = 144 + 25 

⇒ (PO)2 = 169

⇒ PO = 13 cm

X + 5 = 13

PA = X = 8 cm 

**∴ The distance from P to A is 8 cm.**

questions.question: 25 men can complete a task in 16 days. Four days after they started working, 5 more men, with equal workmanship, joined them. How many days will be needed by all to complete the remaining task?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

25 men do the task in 16 days

5 more men had joined them 

**Formula Used:**

If M₁ men can finish W₁ work in D₁ days and M₂ men can finish W₂ work in D₂ days then,

(M₁ × D₁)/W₁ = (M₂ × D₂)/W₂

**Calculation:**

Total work done by 25 men = 25 × 16 = 400 units

Work done in 1st four days = 25 × 4 = 100 units

Remaining work = 400 - 100 = 300 units

Numbers of men joined = 5

Total number of men = 25 + 5 = 30

Remaining work done by 30 men in x days

300 = 30 × x

x = 10

**∴ 10 days will be needed by all to complete the remaining task**
